dedupe_keys.name: large scale mechanized agricultural crop types across mato grosso goias and matopiba brazil 2003 2017

description: This dataset maps annual large-scale mechanised agriculture and its crop rotations across Mato Grosso, Tocantins, Goiás, Maranhão, western Bahia and southern Piauí in Brazil for the 2003 to 2017 growing seasons. The Dataverse record says a published decision-tree algorithm (Spera and others, 2014) was applied to MODIS MOD13Q1 EVI 250 m composites from August 2002 to July 2017, adapted to local crop calendars and extended with single-cropped corn, to identify single cropping of soy, corn or cotton, soy-corn or soy-cotton double cropping and irrigated agriculture; only fields larger than 25 ha were mapped, so estimates are conservative. It was published on 2 October 2019 by Stephanie Spera as version 1.0, GeoTIFFs of about 64 MB each, downloadable and free under CC0 1.0. Coverage is the six states named. Caveats: small farms are missed at 250 m. For simulation it gives cropping systems for drought and heat exposure of Brazil's soy and corn belt, irrigated area for water demand, and origin areas for grain transport to ports. Related catalogue records include the WRI TRAZO field boundaries for South America and the Argentina National Map of Crops.
name: Large-scale mechanized agricultural crop types across Mato Grosso, Goiás and Matopiba, Brazil (2003-2017)
